headlines.title: Kim Kardashian’s new health scare: What is Esophagitis?
headlines.description: Kim Kardashian revealed she’s facing a new health condition in the trailer for season eight of “The Kardashians.”

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: Florida couple says IVF resulted in different biological father
headlines.description: Natalie and Joshua Strong say a blood type mismatch raised questions the day after their daughter was born, with DNA testing later confirming Joshua was not her biological father. NBC News’ Kate Snow reports.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. speaks at anti-vaccination conference as measles cases rise across the country
headlines.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. gave a keynote address at an anti-vaccine conference, as the United States faces the highest number of measles cases in more than 30 years. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal breaks down some of the research behind the claims made by RFK Jr.

headlines.title: Shop High Tech Health Gadgets: Bodyscan, Hyperslides, More
headlines.description: Take wellness to the next level with these gadgets to improve health and recovery. Personal tech expert Jennifer Jolly stops by TODAY to share her top healthcare tech picks, including the Wyze Scale Bodyscan, Nike Air Zoom Hyperslides, the Nanoleaf body sculpting massager, and more!

headlines.title: TODAY Anchors Receive Flu Vaccine Shots Live in Studio 1A
headlines.description: The CDC recommends, with rare exceptions, everyone six months and older get vaccinated to protect against the most common types of the flu. CVS pharmacists stop by TODAY to show how quick and easy it is. NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar also joins to break down everything you need to know about this year’s flu season. (Sponsored by CVS Pharmacy)

headlines.title: Rare deal: Brooks Hyperion 3 running shoes are 50% off at Dick’s Sporting Goods
headlines.description: Brooks sneakers rarely see discounts this deep. Get the Hyperion 3 running shoes for half off at Dick’s Sporting Goods before your size sells out.

headlines.title: Apple just launched its newest iPhone, AirPods and smartwatch — these are the actual upgrades you should know
headlines.description: Apple released its iPhone 18, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5. Here’s everything you need to know about the new products.

headlines.description: New products in September 2026 include the Apple Watch Series 12, AirPods 5 and iPhone 18 Pro. Plus, a Dyson electric toothbrush and Le Creuset x Star Trek line.

headlines.title: The best heating pads for treating sore muscles and menstrual cramps
headlines.description: Heating pads can help to treat aches, soreness and pains in your muscles and joints. I rounded up the best heating pads recommended by experts from brands like Homedics, Bearaby, Sunbeam and more.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania teen dies from measles complications, health officials report
headlines.description: An 18-year-old with measles died from a rare and severe neurological condition that causes inflammation in the brain.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman’s measles death shows risks to people with health problems
headlines.description: The unvaccinated 40-year-old, who died Saturday, had asthma and lung disease, the county coroner’s office said. A test showed the woman tested positive for measles.
